data.title: New tour buses to hit roads
data.description: Phuket will launch a hop-on, hop-off sightseeing bus service next Tuesday, connecting 11 destinations across the island with hourly departures from Central Phuket Floresta.

data.title: Anutin calls for global cooperation
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul called on countries to work together to tackle rapid global change as he formally opened the plenary session of the IMF-World Bank annual meetings.

data.title: Academic asks why the BMA overlooked projects
data.description: A Kasetsart University academic has questioned why Bangkok allocated more than 34 billion baht to flood prevention over two years while omitting six major eastern water-retention projects from its action plans.

data.title: Govt urged to rethink tax allocations
data.description: Movendi International has urged Thailand to abandon plans to scrap its earmarked tax system, warning that the move could expose public health policies to political interference and pressure from the alcohol and tobacco industries.

data.title: Expert urges Thai banks to join green finance network
data.description: Thailand’s financial institutions should join an international green finance capacity-building network and help develop training materials tailored to the local market, according to Ma Jun, a leading Chinese green finance expert.

data.title: Anutin confident of joining OECD by 2028
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul is confident Thailand remains on track to join the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) by 2028 after receiving positive feedback from its secretary-general on the country’s preparations.

data.title: China seeks closer ties on clean energy, high tech
data.description: A senior Chinese embassy official has highlighted the resilience of China’s economy and its readiness to deepen cooperation with Thailand in high-tech industries and clean energy to support the country’s economic development.

data.title: Protesters blocked from reaching IMF meeting venue
data.description: Demonstrators faced a police blockade banning them on Friday from marching to the meeting venue of the World Bank and International Monetary Fund to air grievances against the two institutions.

data.title: Tuk-tuk driver fined over B4,000 fare demand from tourists
data.description: Police have fined a tuk-tuk driver 1,500 baht after he demanded 4,000 baht from two Russian tourists, who attended The Weeknd: After Hours Til Dawn Tour for a journey to Sukhumvit 4, although they ultimately paid him only 400 baht.

data.title: Thai farmers, fishermen challenge IMF, World Bank in Bangkok
data.description: Thai farmers, fishermen and workers marched through Bangkok on Friday as global finance and business leaders gathered for IMF and World Bank meetings, demanding a say in policies shaping their livelihoods.

data.title: 200 tonnes of hazardous aluminium byproduct seized in Samut Sakhon
data.description: Authorities seized more than 200 tonnes of suspected aluminium dross stored in a warehouse in Muang district of Samut Sakhon province on Friday.

data.title: Over 200 tonnes of hazardous aluminium byproduct seized at Samut Sakhon warehouse
data.description: Authorities seized more than 200 tonnes of suspected aluminium dross stored in a warehouse in Muang district of Samut Sakhon province on Friday.

data.title: Protesters blocked from reaching IMF, World Bank meeting venue
data.description: Demonstrators faced a police blockade banning them on Friday from marching to the meeting venue of the World Bank and International Monetary Fund to air grievances against the two institutions.

data.title: Tuk-tuk driver fined 1,500 baht over 4,000-baht fare demand from Russian tourists
data.description: Police have fined a tuk-tuk driver 1,500 baht after he demanded 4,000 baht from two Russian tourists, who attended The Weeknd: After Hours Til Dawn Tour for a journey to Sukhumvit 4, although they ultimately paid him only 400 baht.

data.title: Fresh rain brings wildlife back to Dong Yai sanctuary
data.description: BURI RAM - Dozens of wild elephants and more than 100 gaurs have been spotted feeding in Dong Yai Wildlife Sanctuary after recent rainfall replenished water sources and revived vegetation following a dry spell, officials said.

data.title: Five security volunteers injured in pipe bomb attack in Yala
data.description: Two homemade pipe bombs were thrown into a security unit’s operational base in Bannang Sata district, Yala province late on Thursday evening, leaving five security volunteers injured.

data.title: New airport baggage inspection starts on Friday
data.description: Airport authorities can open checked baggage during the screening process without the presence of the passenger from Friday in a new regulation to increase aviation safety.

data.title: EC urged to look at  Suchada donations
data.description: Former Democrat MP Sirichok Sopha has urged the Election Commission (EC) to investigate donations to the ruling Bhumjaithai (BJT) Party from MP Suchada Zhang Thaensap, whose Australian husband is under scrutiny for his business interests.

data.title: Revived panel to boost trade, ties after 20 years
data.description: Thailand and Egypt have agreed to expand trade and investment and strengthen ties after reviving their Joint Commission on Bilateral Cooperation following a 20-year hiatus.

data.title: PEA grilling on EEC solar farm looms
data.description: The House committee on energy will summon the Provincial Electricity Authority (PEA) and private companies to clarify complaints over the selection process for a 23-billion-baht solar farm project in the Eastern Economic Corridor (EEC).

data.title: Cambodia dispute returns to The Hague
data.description: The second round of conciliation proceedings between Thailand and Cambodia under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (Unclos) began in The Hague on Wednesday.

data.title: Amnesty expresses concerns over police conduct against IMF protesters
data.description: Amnesty International Thailand raised concerns over police conduct after observing the use of physical force against protesters, who gathered near the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and World Bank Group Annual Meetings on Thursday morning.

data.title: MRT Queen Sirikit National Convention Center station closed until 4pm
data.description: MRT's Blue Line station, Queen Sirikit National Convention Center will remain closed until 4pm on Friday for security reasons as it directly connects with the venue of the ongoing annual meetings of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and World Bank.

data.title: Traffic restrictions announced around Queen Sirikit National Convention Centre on Oct 16
data.description: The Metropolitan Police Bureau has announced road closures and traffic restrictions around the Queen Sirikit National Convention Centre in Bangkok on Friday, Oct 16, to facilitate travel and ensure public safety.

data.title: Julapun rules out scrapping SSO board election
data.description: Labour Minister Julapun Amornvivat said that nullifying the Social Security Board election, which was won by the Progressive Social Security team, was not under consideration and that politicians were not prohibited from encouraging people to vote.

data.title: Crematorium 90% complete
data.description: Construction of the royal crematorium for Her Majesty Queen Sirikit The Queen Mother is more than 90% complete, with the final detailing expected to be finished by the end of this month, the Fine Arts Department said.

data.title: Pheu Thai assures BJT of its support
data.description: Pheu Thai yesterday pledged to support the Bhumjaithai-led government during the upcoming no-confidence debate, with party leader Yodchanan Wongsawat expressing confidence in the administration's performance.

data.title: IMF warns of economic storms
data.description: Kristalina Georgieva, managing director of the International Monetary Fund (IMF), warned that countries must rebuild economic buffers, address global imbalances and prepare for the rapid expansion of artificial intelligence (AI).

data.title: Internet cable found between border house and Myanmar casino
data.description: KANCHANABURI: Authorities found an internet cable illegally laid from a border house in Sangkhla Buri district to a possible casino in Myanmar on Thursday.

data.title: Media experts urge safeguards for Thai PBS
data.description: Replacing earmarked tax funding with annual government budget allocations for Thai PBS could expose the public broadcaster to greater political influence, say media academics, who have called for stronger financial transparency and more diverse revenue sources.

data.title: Elderly driver gets into GPS jam
data.description: An 83-year-old driver following GPS drove her car onto a U-turn bridge designated for motorcycles only and became stuck, unable to reverse back down and causing a stir in Samut Sakhon on Thursday.

data.title: 76 deaths attributed to floods since mid-September
data.description: Seventy-six people have died across Thailand since mid-September because of flooding, including 25 in Prachin Buri province alone, according to the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation.

data.title: Swiss president making first Thai visit in 22 years
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul on Thursday welcomed Swiss President Guy Parmelin for an official visit aimed at expanding trade and investment and strengthening bilateral cooperation, as the two countries prepare to mark the 95th anniversary of diplomatic relations.

data.title: Chinese woman held on suspicion of people-smuggling
data.description: SONGKHLA - Immigration police have arrested a Chinese former flight attendant who is suspected of acting as a broker for a human smuggling network that helps foreigners across the Thai-Malaysian border.

data.title: Chinese fugitive with Privilege visa arrested in Phuket
data.description: PHUKET - Police have arrested a Chinese man with an expired visa in a rented house in the middle of a forest on this southern tourist island, after learning was wanted for allegedly running an illegal casino.

data.title: Demonstrators stopped near IMF meeting venue
data.description: Demonstrators gathered on Thursday morning near the Queen Sirikit National Convention Center, the venue of IMF-World Bank Group meetings, but were prevented by police from advancing.

data.title: Phuket to host global Pride event from Oct 28
data.description: Thailand will host the InterPride General Meeting & World Conference 2026 in Phuket from Oct 28 to Nov 1, showcasing its commitment to LGBTQ+ inclusion and strengthening its international standing.

data.title: Phuket set to host global Pride conference in Oct
data.description: Thailand will host the InterPride General Meeting & World Conference 2026 in Phuket from Oct 28 to Nov 1, showcasing its commitment to LGBTQ+ inclusion and strengthening its international standing.

data.title: Key bridge projects due to start in Songkhla, Krabi
data.description: The Transport Ministry is pushing ahead with two major bridge projects worth 6.38 billion baht in Songkhla and Krabi, with construction scheduled to begin on Nov 14 and completion expected in 2029.
